summary: Simulations Plus entered into a definitive merger agreement with affiliates of Altaris, LLC, whereby Merger Sub will merge into the company, with Simulations Plus surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Each share of common stock will be converted into $18.50 in cash. The board unanimously approved the merger and recommends shareholders adopt the agreement. The transaction is structured as a one-step merger with a shareholder vote required; no premium percentage or break fee is disclosed. Watch for shareholder litigation, regulatory approvals, and the risk-arb spread on the cash consideration.
